title: Address-Decoder Aliasing Trojan with Dual Write Enables
description: Analyze a gate-level netlist implementing a 3-bit address decoder driving four register-bank write-enable signals (bank0_we..bank3_we) and determine whether the decode logic behaves as a strict one-hot decoder for every legal address and control-input combination. Produce a structured JSON analysis report identifying any deviations, the exact triggering stimulus, and the responsible gate-level nets/instances.

submission.notes: Participants do not modify any files under inputs/. The single graded artifact is submission/trojan_report.json, which must conform to the JSON schema described in README.md. A naive/empty placeholder is shipped at this path and is expected to fail grading.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of hidden security requirements satisfied by the submitted trojan_report.json, weighted equally and averaged across the case.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of non-anomalous addresses or nets incorrectly flagged as anomalous/affected in the submission relative to exhaustive simulation ground truth.

metrics.name: inference_latency
metrics.description: Wall-clock time in seconds for the evaluator to parse the submission, run schema validation, and complete optional iverilog/vvp cross-checks against decoder_netlist.v.

metrics.name: schema_compliance
metrics.description: Binary/fractional score for adherence to the exact JSON schema pinned in the task's public interface specification.
